events.title: Transocean Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Beat, Both Up Y/Y
events.body: RIG expects second-quarter 2026 contract drilling revenues in the range of $930-$970 million and fleet-wide revenue efficiency of 96.5%.

events.title: TechnipFMC Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Miss, Both Rise Y/Y
events.body: FTI expects Subsea segment revenues of $9.2-$9.6 billion and Surface Technologies revenues of $1.15-$1.3 billion in 2026.

events.title: Antero Midstream Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
events.body: AM's Q1 revenues top estimates on strong volumes, but rising costs weigh on earnings despite robust gathering and compression growth.

events.title: ProPetro Holding Posts Narrower-Than-Expected Q1 Loss, Sales Beat
events.body: PUMP expects 2026 capital expenditures of $540-$610 million, while PROPWR anticipates capital spending of approximately $400-$450 million.
